key_insight: An AI-derived focal TIL score captures localized immune infiltration in lung adenocarcinoma and was associated with overall survival in patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_relevance: Routine H&E slides may provide a standardized prognostic biomarker that outperformed PD-L1 in this study, but treatment-selection utility remains unproven.
method: Detect lymphocytes using a deep learning model trained on immunohistochemistry-derived ground truth.
Segment tumor and tumor-adjacent stroma using consensus pathologist annotations.
Quantify tile-level lymphocyte density to capture spatially localized infiltration.
evidence_signal: Analytical validation yielded lymphocyte-detection CCC 0.90 and region-segmentation Dice 0.87; among 685 ICI-treated patients, the focal TIL score was associated with overall survival (HR 0.60, 95% CI 0.48–0.75; P<0.001).
watch_item: An association in ICI-treated patients does not establish prediction of treatment benefit; independent validation is needed before clinical implementation.
paper_title: Quantifying Localized Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes by Deep Learning on H&E Images: Analytical Validation and Prognostic Value in Lung Adenocarcinoma
